opening_hours: Customer support is available Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm. We are closed on weekends and public holidays.
order_tracking: You can track your order on our website with the order number. Tracking information is updated every 24 hours.
invoices: The invoice is emailed automatically when the order ships. If you need an invoice with your company's tax ID, ask for it within 30 days of the purchase.
gift_cards: Gift cards can be bought online from 10 to 500 dollars. They are valid for 12 months and can't be exchanged for cash.
stock: If a product is out of stock, you can sign up on its page to get an email when it's available again. Restocking usually takes 2 to 3 weeks.
wholesale: We offer wholesale prices for purchases of 20 units or more. Write to us with your company details to get a quote.
physical_stores: We are an online-only store: we don't have physical stores or showrooms. All purchases are made through the website.
account: You can reset your password from the login page with the 'Forgot my password' link. To change the email of your account, write to customer support.
